verses.1: For the destruction of the son of time, for David’s sake.
verses.2: May the LORD be praised with all my heart; I will recount all your miracles.
verses.3: I will rejoice and be glad in you, O Lord. Your name will be praised forever.
verses.4: In their next attempt, they will be defeated and destroyed by you.
verses.5: For you have made judgments and laws; you have settled them so that they may serve as guidelines for justice.
verses.6: You have rebelled against God. You have destroyed the wicked. You have condemned them to eternal punishment.
verses.7: May they be destroyed forever, and may their cities be lost; may their memories be forgotten.
verses.8: And Jehovah will forever sit as a judge on His throne.
verses.9: And he will rule over Constantinople with justice. He will judge the people fairly and justly.
verses.10: And Jehovah shall be humble before His enemies, humble in the time of adversity.
verses.11: And those who know your name will be assured that you have not abandoned your followers, O LORD.
verses.12: Sing to Jehovah, who sits on the throne. Proclaim his praises among all nations.
verses.13: For those who seek bloodshed, they remember not the cries of the poor.
verses.14: O LORD, look upon my misery; see my suffering from those who hate me. From those who cause me death.
verses.15: So that all your songs may be recorded in the courtyards of Beth Zion Agila during your reign.
verses.16: The nations were scattered by chaos. They did what they wanted with the land; their feet were bound together.
verses.17: Hear, O LORD, what judgment You have carried out through Your hand. The wicked have been punished accordingly.
verses.18: The wicked will return to their former ways. All nations that forget God will be destroyed.
verses.19: For forever, one will not forget the cries of the poor. Their cries will continue to be remembered forever.
verses.20: May the LORD not allow people to judge others based on their appearances.
verses.21: The LORD has set them apart for them. Then all those nations will know that they are descendants of man.
